title: 量化交易时区/结算事故复盘与合规整改

sources.title: SEC Charges Knight Capital With Violations of Market Access Rule
sources.key_facts: Knight Capital Americas LLC agreed to pay $12 million to settle charges; violated Rule 15c3-5(b); August 1 2012 incident; 4 million+ orders sent in 45 minutes for 154 stocks; $460M+ financial loss confirmed

sources.title: In the Matter of Knight Capital Americas LLC — SEC Administrative Order Release No. 34-70694
sources.key_facts: Admin Proc. File No. 3-15570; Rule 15c3-5(b) violation; 8 SMARS servers; deployment July 27-August 1 2012; 1 server missed deployment; 97 pre-market automated emails starting 8:01 AM ET; 212 customer orders triggered 4M+ child orders; 397M+ shares in 154 stocks; $460M loss; $12M penalty

sources.title: Findings Regarding the Market Events of May 6, 2010 — SEC/CFTC Joint Report
sources.key_facts: Flash crash start: 2:32 PM EDT May 6 2010; Waddell & Reed sold 75,000 E-Mini S&P 500 contracts (~$4.1B); Dow dropped 998.5 points (~9%); CME circuit breaker triggered at 2:45:28 PM; 36-minute event; $1 trillion in market cap temporarily lost

sources.title: Small Entity Compliance Guide: Rule 15c3-5 — Risk Management Controls for Brokers or Dealers with Market Access
sources.key_facts: Rule adopted November 3 2010; effective January 14 2011; compliance deadline July 14 2011; requires pre-trade financial and regulatory risk controls; prohibits unfiltered/naked market access; annual CEO certification required

sources.title: SEC T+1 Settlement FAQ — Shortening the Securities Transaction Settlement Cycle
sources.key_facts: Rule 15c6-1 amended; T+1 settlement cycle effective May 28 2024; moved from T+2 to T+1; scope includes equities, corporate debt, unit investment trusts; Rule 17Ad-27 new requirement for clearing agencies

sources.title: FCA Market Watch 59 — MiFIR Transaction Reporting Observations (April 2019)
sources.key_facts: Field 28 (trading date & time) must be reported in UTC not local time; FCA identified DST transition errors as common compliance failure; British Summer Time (BST) is UTC+1; firms must adjust to UTC when UK clocks change; MiFIR replaced MiFID I local time reporting with mandatory UTC

sources.title: Knightmare: A DevOps Cautionary Tale — Doug Seven (citing SEC administrative order)
sources.key_facts: Deployment July 27-31 2012, one server per day; 8th server missed new code; Power Peg code deactivated 2005; 97 emails sent 8:01-9:30 AM ET ('Power Peg disabled'); system shutdown ~9:58 AM ET; $460M loss from $365M initial capital; 4M executions, 397M+ shares, 154 stocks; net long $3.5B / net short $3.15B

sources.title: CME Group Trading Hours and Daily Settlement Times
sources.key_facts: E-Mini S&P 500 daily settlement: 14:59:30-15:00:00 CT (= 20:00 UTC in EST / 19:00 UTC in CDT); trading hours CME Globex during EDT: 7:30 PM EDT to 5:30 PM EDT next day; DST transition changes UTC offset by 1 hour

sources.title: DTCC MAY 2024 T+1 Conversion Guide
sources.key_facts: T+1 effective May 28 2024; affirmation rates target: increased from 85% pre-T+1 to 97% YTD Dec 2024; straight-through processing (STP) required; Rule 17Ad-27 compliance deadline

sources.title: 2010 Flash Crash — Wikipedia (sourcing SEC/CFTC joint report)
sources.key_facts: May 6 2010 2:32 PM EDT start; 998.5 point Dow drop; 75,000 E-Mini contracts ($4.1B) sold by Waddell & Reed; 9% execution rate of prior-minute volume algorithm; CME Stop Logic triggered 2:45:28 PM; 8 S&P 500 stocks traded at $0.01; circuit breakers installed across 404 NYSE S&P500 stocks by June 16 2010 (10% threshold, 5-minute window)
